name: Network Engineer
text: Decrypt orders take half the work while she is home.

name: Guilt
text: Her mood drops when her party kills Linked.

name: Shut-in
text: Never goes on scavenges unless the mission needs her.

name: Field Surgeon
text: Fittings she leads succeed 20% more often.

name: Oath
text: Will not fit Network-grade limbs. If the colony fits one anyway, she warns you; after a second, she leaves.

name: Keeps Score
text: Happier while there is more food than mouths, unhappier when not.

name: Ghost in the Wire
text: Hacks from two tiles away without a kit. The Linked cannot Override it.

name: Not Human?
text: Humanity starts at 0 and grows back in the colony, up to 60. Others are uneasy near it until 30.

name: Network Echo
text: Sometimes the Linked notice it: an extra Linked patrol.

name: Grew Up Here
text: His mood follows the colony's humanity.
